## 3. Core Capability & Value Matrix (Ranked by Complexity)

### Level 1 • Enterprise Architecture (Highest Complexity)
- **Domain:** Enterprise HRIS, Payroll (PPh 21 TER) & People Analytics

- **Target Audience:** Board of Directors, VP Human Capital, HR Managers, Business Owners.

### Level 2 • Governance & Global Operations
- **Domain:** Global People Operations, SOP & ISO/SMK3 Governance
- **Problem Solved:** Non-standardized cross-border/multi-timezone HR operations, quality/OHS compliance gaps, and high 90-day turnover driven by fragmented onboarding.
- **Delivered Solution:** SOP standardization anchored in ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 & SMK3 frameworks, 360-degree review systems, and unified onboarding pipelines (+30% 90-day retention, 26 countries experience).
- **Target Audience:** Multinational/Remote Companies, Manufacturing, Scaling HR Teams.

### Level 3 • Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding

### Level 4 • Corporate Learning & Development

### Level 5 • Executive Mentorship

## 4. In-Depth System Architecture Breakdown

### 4.1. Automated HRIS & Payroll Engine (27-Sheet Architecture)
- **Technology Stack:** Google Sheets, Google Apps Script, REST API, Google Drive API, Zero-Macro (Zero VBA).
- **Core Modules:** Master Karyawan, Single-Entry Log Cuti, Perhitungan Hari Kerja Efektif, PPh 21 TER (PP 58/2023) Kategori A/B/C, Rekonsiliasi Tahunan PPh 21 Pasal 17 Masa Pajak Terakhir, BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan (dynamic wage caps), Kalkulator Pesangon PP 35/2021, Pemantauan Ambang Batas PKWT 5 Tahun, 33 Aturan Audit Integritas Otomatis (Cek Data), Dashboard Eksekutif 20 KPI.
- **Deterministic Safeguards:** Zero LLM hallucinations on payroll numbers. Calculations are 100% algebraic and deterministic.
- **Interactive Live Simulator:** https://nugrohoamdalportfolio.dpdns.org/hris-dashboard.html

### 4.2. Recruitment & Manpower Planning (MPP) Hub (10 Integrated Modules)
- **Technology Stack:** Google Sheets, Apps Script, Google Forms Webhook, Dynamic SLA Engine.
- **Core Modules:** Kuota MPP Departemen, Formulir Permintaan Karyawan (FPTK), Alur Persetujuan Bertingkat, Tracking SLA Hari Kerja Dinamis (mengecualikan akhir pekan & hari libur nasional), Sourcing Funnel Tracking (Sourcing -> Screening -> User Interview -> Offering -> Onboarding), Consent Log Database Kandidat, Generator Undangan Wawancara WA & Email Otomatis.
- **Interactive Live Simulator:** https://nugrohoamdalportfolio.dpdns.org/recruitment-dashboard.html

### 4.3. Employee Value Proposition (EVP) & Culture Diagnostic Engine
- **Technology Stack:** Google Sheets, Google Apps Script, VoE Semantic Parser, Chart.js.
- **Core Modules:** Credibility Gap Analysis (Management Claims vs. Employee Reality), Evidence Gap Audit, Give-Get Ratio Modeling, Voice of Employee (VoE) Qualitative Analysis, Priority Action Score (PAS) for 0-30 Day Quick Wins, 90-Day EVP Index Simulation (3.30 to 3.95).
